content.comment_body: Hello, I've created a PLC program with display messages, but when I attempt to program the PLC, I receive an error indicating that programming from PC to [product_name] isn't possible. I've attached the program file.

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. All your message text entries are incomplete. The 'message text' block has an output that needs to be connected, for example, to an open clamp as I have done in my example. In simulation, wiring is not necessary, but you cannot transfer the program to the [product_name] unless this connection is made.
Thanks! I thought it only needed to be wired to an open contact in FBD.
No, this is required in LAD as well. It's just not as obvious in LAD diagrams.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered issues when programming display message blocks in PLCs. The main challenge was that proper wiring is not required in simulation mode, but is essential when transferring programs to real devices. This difference led to incomplete setups and errors during program transfer.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the programming process to be consistent between simulation and actual hardware transfer, and desire clear instructions regarding proper wiring practices for message text blocks in both FBD and LAD programming.
